newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent closes lower as technical support broken.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent closes lower as technical support broken.

text.p: IPE Brent futures closed lower on Friday after a last minute flurry of selling after the front-month contract fell below the $22.30 level which had supported it all week, traders said.
"It was just a bit of technical selling," said one trader. "The market's nervous and when $22.30 broke a few people got out. They weren't prepared to sit on longs over the weekend."
March Brent settled 16 cents lower at $22.26 having shed more than 15 cents in the last 10 minutes of trade.
The contract has lost 29 cents since last Friday's close at $22.54.

"The market's still in the doldrums," said another trader. "But at least it's braked last week's fall. I think we'll continue to see it trading in the $22.20 to $22.80 range, at least for the early part of the week."
Last week, March Brent shed some $1.30 over the week.
Traders said that continued weakness in gas oil due to relatively mild weather across Europe was also weighing on the Brent complex.

The February gas oil contract settled $8.0 lower at the psychological support level of $200. Traders noted it was the first time the prompt contract had hit that level since August 30. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
